newsitem.title: CANADA: Morrison says hearing fears behind move.
newsitem.headline: Morrison says hearing fears behind move.

text.p: Morrison Petroleums Ltd said on Sunday it believed Canadian 88 Energy Corp withdrew its C$652 million takeover bid over uncertainty regarding a hearing before securities regulators, contrary to assertions made by Canadian 88.

Canadian 88 said earlier it pulled its offer for Morrison off the table after new information suggested a much-watched natural gas well in southwestern Alberta was likely dry, which lowered the company's value.

But Morrison chief executive Gordon Stollery said in a statement said that he was not aware of any new data regarding the status of the drilling operations that would lead to a termination of the bid.
He said he concluded uncertainty behind the hearing before the Ontario and Alberta securities commissions, which had been scheduled for Monday, was the reason behind the move.
Analysts have said they believed one or more new bidders for Morrison were likely to emerge shortly. Morrison said it was keeping its proprietary data room open in hopes of attracting new suitors.
